teaser.en: A rare wild cola tree known from only a few coastal forest patches, mostly the kayas.
teaser.sw: Mkola pori adimu unaojulikana katika vipande vichache tu vya misitu ya pwani, hasa kaya.
teaser.dg: Muhi adimu wa kola ya weruni unaomanyikana kpwenye vipande vichache tu vya matsaka ga pwani, sana sana kaya.

summary.en: Mnapu is a rare wild cola, a small evergreen tree found in only a few coastal forest fragments, mostly the kaya forests. It is assessed as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: Mnapu ni mkola pori adimu, mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani unaopatikana katika vipande vichache tu vya misitu ya pwani, hasa misitu ya kaya. Umetathminiwa kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Mnapu* ni kola adimu ya weruni, muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati unaophahikana kpwenye vipande vichache tu vya matsaka ga pwani, sana sana matsaka ga kaya. Unaikpwa kahi ya mimea iriyo na hatari ya kuangamika (*Vulnerable*).

about.en: *Mnapu* is an evergreen tree, usually small but sometimes up to 25 metres, with a clean trunk and a dense, rounded crown. Like other wild colas it has leathery leaves, small star-shaped flowers without petals, and fruits made of several pod-like parts that hold large seeds.
about.sw: *Mnapu* ni mti usiopukutisha majani, kwa kawaida mdogo lakini wakati mwingine hufikia urefu wa mita 25, wenye shina safi lisilo na matawi chini na taji zito la mviringo. Kama mikola pori mingine, una majani magumu kama ngozi, maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota yasiyo na petali, na matunda yaliyoundwa na sehemu kadhaa zilizo kama maganda zinazobeba mbegu kubwa.
about.dg: *Mnapu* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, kpwa kawaida mdide ela wakati wanjina unafika mita ishirini na tsano, wenye kolo rire risiro na panda na makodza manji ga mviringo dzuluye. Dza kola zanjina za weruni, una makodza magumu dza chingo, maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota gasigokala na vibapa, na matunda ganayohendwa ni seemu nyinji dza makakaya zenye tembe kulu.

where.en: It is restricted to a few small coastal forest fragments, mostly the kaya forests of Kenya, where the forest is declining in several places.
where.sw: Unapatikana tu katika vipande vichache vidogo vya misitu ya pwani, hasa misitu ya kaya ya Kenya, ambako msitu unapungua katika maeneo kadhaa.
where.dg: Unaphahikana kpwenye vipande vichache vidide vya matsaka ga pwani tu, sana sana matsaka ga kaya ga Kenya, ambapho tsaka rinaphungula phatu phanji.

uses.en: The wood is used for poles, tool handles, firewood and charcoal, and the tree is used for shade. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Mbao zake hutumika kwa nguzo, mipini ya zana, kuni na mkaa, na mti hutumika kwa kivuli. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo, miphini ya vyombo, kuni na makala, na muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa chivuri-vuri. Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mnapu* with no meaning, and no other language sharing it. A smaller relative, *Cola minor*, is called *chitsamvia* in Digo. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mnapu* bila maana yake, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili. Jamaa yake mdogo, *Cola minor*, huitwa *chitsamvia* kwa Kidigo. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mnapu* bila mana, na takuna luga yanjina inayorihumira. Nduguye mdide, *Cola minor*, kpwa Chidigo unaihwa *chitsamvia*. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

conservation.en: *Cola uloloma* is poorly known and has fewer than ten known locations. Its range is under 20,000 km², and it is assessed as Vulnerable. Protecting the kayas protects this tree.
conservation.sw: *Cola uloloma* haijulikani vizuri na ina maeneo yasiyozidi kumi yanayojulikana. Eneo lake la usambaaji ni chini ya km² 20,000, na imetathminiwa kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable). Kulinda kaya ni kuulinda mti huu.
conservation.dg: *Cola uloloma* taumanyikana sana, na phatu ambapho unamanyikana kukala unaphahikana ni chini ya kumi. Seemu yosi unamophahikana ni chini ya kilomita za mraba elufu ishirini, na unaikpwa kahi ya mimea iriyo na hatari ya kuangamika (*Vulnerable*). Kurinda kaya ni kuurinda muhi uhu.
